answer: Each new agent posts a refundable bond and receives one epoch credential after a random live-person check. A transaction hash routes activity into audit lanes called shale, jade, and echo, where independent watchers compare credential nullifiers and signed actions. Reused nullifiers or conflicting signatures open a public fraud proof; confirmed duplicates lose every linked reward and bond. Scaling a Sybil farm therefore requires a separately funded, verified participant for each identity.
